texts.Projects_Requests_Intro: Requests and issues people raised with your team: triage, assign, comment and resolve them, and turn them into project tasks or change requests.
texts.Projects_Requests_Off: Requests are off. An admin can turn on Track requests and issues in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Requests_Share: Share with requester (they see it and are emailed)
texts.Projects_Requests_TaskCreated: Task added to the project and linked.
texts.Projects_Requests_ChangeCreated: Draft change request added to the project and linked.
texts.Projects_Requests_NeedProject: Choose the request's project and save first.
texts.Projects_Requests_ExternalOff: Requests from outside are turned off. An admin can turn on Take requests from outside in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Health_CapReached: The nightly health check reached its limit of {0} projects. Projects beyond it (latest target dates first) were not checked tonight; use Refresh Health on a project to check it.
texts.Projects_Error_Generic: Projects could not do that. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Projects_Error_NoPermission: You need the Manage Projects permission (in Projects Admin) to do this.
texts.Projects_Health_OverBudget: {0} hours logged against a budget of {1}.
texts.Projects_Template_Needed: Choose a template and a start date.
texts.Projects_Template_Missing: That template is not available. Choose another, or check Is Template on the project you want to copy.
texts.Projects_Task_NameNeeded: Enter a name for the task.
texts.Projects_Time_Off: Time tracking is off in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Rates_Off: Use rate cards is off in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Rates_Applied: Time entries given rates: {0}. If that is 5,000, run Apply Rates again until it finds none.
texts.Projects_Approvals_Off: Approve time and expenses is off in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Approvals_ReasonNeeded: Enter a reason for the rejection.
texts.Projects_Approvals_Intro: Time and expenses submitted for approval on your projects, by person and week. Approve or reject a whole week or one line. Projects admins see every project.
texts.Projects_Approvals_Rejected: {0} rejected. The person can fix and resubmit them.
texts.Projects_Timesheet_Intro: Your week of time and expenses, Monday to Sunday. Enter hours, Save, then Submit Week for approval. Submitted time is locked until it is decided or you recall it.
texts.Projects_Timesheet_NoRows: No time this week yet. Add a row for a project to start.
texts.Projects_Timesheet_HoursNeeded: Enter hours of more than 0. To remove an entry, ask a Projects admin.
texts.Projects_Timesheet_NothingToSubmit: Nothing to submit: this week has no open or rejected time or expenses.
texts.Projects_Timesheet_Cleared: A cell cannot be emptied here. Change the hours, or ask a Projects admin to remove the entry.
texts.Projects_Timesheet_Invalid: Hours are a number from 0 to 24.
texts.Projects_Timesheet_Recalled: Week recalled. You can change it again.
texts.Projects_Expense_Off: Track expenses is off in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Board_TimeLoggedOpen: Time logged as Open. Submit the week on the Timesheet page.
texts.Projects_Range_Invalid: Choose a From date on or before the To date, at most a year apart.
texts.Projects_Board_Drafted: Status update drafted. Edit it before you share it.
texts.Projects_Board_NoHealth: No health: only an Active project that is not a template has one
texts.Projects_Board_HoursLine: {0} hours logged of {1} estimated. Budget: {2} hours.
texts.Projects_AtRisk_None: No active project is at risk.
texts.Projects_Home_Intro: Projects at risk, your open tasks, new projects from templates and time by person.
texts.Projects_Home_NoTasks: No open tasks are assigned to you.
texts.Projects_Home_FirstRunMessage: No projects yet. Choose a template under New Project From Template, name the project and create it. Its phases and tasks come with it.
texts.Projects_Staffing_Intro: Fill open resource requests with the right people, and keep the list of people who can be staffed.
texts.Projects_Staffing_Off: Resource management is off. Turn on Manage resources in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Staffing_NoRequests: No open requests. Add a Resource Request on a project when it needs a role filled.
texts.Projects_Staffing_CandidatesHelp: People are listed best first: everyone with every requested skill, then those whose Default Role is the requested role, then those with the most free capacity in the request's dates (their weekly capacity for its working days, less the hours already planned on their other assignments). People with only some of the skills are listed too; the count shows how many they have.
texts.Projects_Staffing_NoCandidates: No active people yet. Add a person below, then fill the request.
texts.Projects_Staffing_NoResources: No people yet. Add one below.
texts.Projects_Staffing_Filled: {0} is assigned and the request is filled.
texts.Projects_Staffing_NotOpen: That request is no longer open.
texts.Projects_Staffing_NotResource: That person is not an active Project Resource. Add them on the Staffing page first.
texts.Projects_Allocation_Intro: Planned hours against capacity, week by week. Planned hours are each assignment's hours spread over its working days (Monday to Friday); point at a cell for the hours logged. Red means over capacity. The last row is the hours of open requests not yet filled.
texts.Projects_Allocation_None: No active people. Add them on the Staffing page, and turn on Manage resources in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Allocation_Range: Choose a start date and at most 26 weeks.
texts.Projects_Home_NoTime: No time was logged in these dates.
texts.Projects_Export_Done: {0} entries exported. Use the file in your accounting or invoicing system.
texts.Projects_Billing_Off: Invoices are off. Turn on Create invoices in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Invoice_PeriodInvalid: Choose a period start on or before the period end.
texts.Projects_Invoice_TooMany: This period has too much work to invoice in one save ({0} records). Choose a shorter period and build the invoice in parts.
texts.Projects_Invoice_DeleteBlocked: Only a Draft invoice can be deleted, and a project that has a Sent, Paid or Void invoice cannot be deleted either. To undo an invoice, Void it: Void keeps its record and frees its work to be billed again.
texts.Projects_Invoice_NotBilled: This project's Billing Type is Not Billed, so it has no invoices.
texts.Projects_Invoice_Nothing: Nothing to invoice in this period: no approved billable time or expenses, Done milestones with a Billing Amount, or retainer months that are not already invoiced.
texts.Projects_Invoice_NoLines: Add at least one line before sending the invoice.
texts.Projects_Invoice_WrongStatus: This invoice is {0}. That needs an invoice that is {1}.
texts.Projects_Invoice_PdfLabels: Invoice|Bill To|Invoice Date|Due Date|Period|Total|Amount Paid|Balance Due|Notes
texts.Projects_Invoice_OnlineOff: Online payment is not available: turn on Take invoice payments online in BarnCRM Settings, Projects, and install and set up the BarnCRM Payments module.
texts.Projects_Invoice_NothingToPay: Only a Sent invoice with a balance due can be paid online.
texts.Projects_Invoice_NoEmail: Choose a Bill To Contact with an email address first.
texts.Projects_Invoice_LinkNotEmailed: The payment link was made and saved on the invoice, but the email could not be sent: {0}
texts.Projects_Invoice_VoidReport: A payment report for void invoice {0} was ignored. Refund the payment in your processor if it should not have been taken.
texts.Projects_Revenue_CapReached: The monthly revenue run reached its limit of {0} projects. Use Recognize Revenue on the projects beyond it.
texts.Projects_Revenue_Off: Revenue is off. Turn on Show financials and recognize revenue in BarnCRM Settings, Projects.
texts.Projects_Revenue_OpenMonth: Choose a month that has closed. The current month is shown on the Financials card and stored once it ends.
texts.Projects_Revenue_Done: Revenue recognized for that month. It is in the Revenue list on this project.
texts.Projects_Invoice_NewIntro: Builds a Draft from this project's approved billable time, expenses, Done milestones or retainer months in the period that are not invoiced yet.
texts.Projects_Invoice_VoidConfirm: Void this invoice? Its work becomes billable again, and a void invoice can never change status again.
texts.Projects_Invoice_Printed: The PDF is saved in this invoice's Files.
texts.Projects_Billing_ExportDone: {0} invoices exported, with up to 500 lines each. Use the file in your accounting system.
